summary.name: HyperKitty
summary.one_liner: HyperKitty is a web interface for browsing and searching GNU Mailman v3 mailing list archives.
use_cases: host a web archive for a Mailman 3 mailing list
browse past mailing list discussions in a browser
summary.what_it_does: The page is a GitLab repository page for the HyperKitty project, a web interface for accessing GNU Mailman v3 archives. The page text shows only the repository branch and tag selector (branches including master and release/1.0 and 1.1, tags from v1.2.1 up to 1.3.12) and an empty file listing, so no feature details are visible here. The listing describes it as available under GPL-3.0 and written in Python, with a demo and source code link. The page does not describe specific features beyond archive access.
notable: Web front end for GNU Mailman v3 archives
Source hosted on GitLab with release branches and tags up to 1.3.12
caveats: Page text shows only repository navigation; features are not described in detail
